recognize_zh: 臨床照片中前臂皮膚有多條平行、橫向的淡紅色線狀紅斑，並伴隨褐色色素沉著區塊，呈鞭打狀排列，符合 bleomycin 引起的鞭狀皮膚炎及其後的發炎後色素沉著。
features: Multiple parallel, linear to curvilinear erythematous streaks across the forearm
Brownish post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, most prominent in the upper patch
A few small dark crusted points, possibly from scratching
describe_en: Clinical photograph of the forearm shows multiple parallel, linear and curvilinear erythematous macules and thin plaques in a whip-like distribution, with an adjacent area of brownish hyperpigmentation. A few small dark crusted foci are present, possibly related to pruritus and scratching, without bullae or ulceration. Histologic assessment is not possible from this image. In the setting of ABVD chemotherapy, findings are consistent with bleomycin-induced flagellate dermatitis evolving to hyperpigmentation.

ddx.vs: Excoriations consist of linear erosions and crusts along scratch lines, whereas flagellate dermatitis forms erythematous streaks that can appear without prior scratching.
Phytophotodermatitis follows plant-juice contact plus sun exposure with drip-shaped streaks in exposed areas, rather than widespread whip-like lesions including the trunk.
Dermatomyositis has associated heliotrope rash, Gottron papules, and myositis, which are absent in drug-induced flagellate dermatitis.
